review:
Thor as the god of multipliers, next to Yggdrasil on a pay-anywhere gem grid with refilling reels. Multipliers can land in the base game too, and those in the same spin add together.

In free spins, Thor collects every multiplier and applies the running total to wins, so a long bonus can build something big. Very high volatility, a 5,000x max and a 97.17% RTP – one of the best around. Free spins land about once every 163 spins, more often than the Bonanza games.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
